cb-n-seasons.label: SRH seasons in the warehouse
cb-n-seasons.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
cb-n-seasons.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won FROM matches m WHERE (m.team1_id IN (1) OR m.team2_id IN (1)) AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

cb-n.label: SRH chases needing ten or more an over at halfway
cb-n.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
cb-n.filters: Required rate at the start of the eleventh over
cb-n.query: WITH h AS (SELECT d.innings_id, SUM(d.total_runs) runs10, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls10, MAX(CASE WHEN d.over_num >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) reached FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id WHERE i.innings_number = 2 GROUP BY d.innings_id), p AS (SELECT d.innings_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.over_num < 10 THEN d.total_runs ELSE 0 END) r, SUM(CASE WHEN d.over_num < 10 AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) b FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id) SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, i.batting_team_id bt, m.winner_id w, (i1.runs + 1 - p.r) * 6.0 / (120 - p.b) rrr FROM innings i JOIN h ON h.innings_id = i.innings_id JOIN p ON p.innings_id = i.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id JOIN innings i1 ON i1.match_id = i.match_id AND i1.innings_number = 1 WHERE i.innings_number = 2 AND h.reached = 1 AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL

cb-early.label: SRH seasons starting with three or more defeats in the first five decided matches
cb-early.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
cb-early.query: WITH ms AS (SELECT m.match_id, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, replace(m.date, '/', '-') dt, m.venue_id, v.city, m.team1_id t1, m.team2_id t2, m.winner_id w FROM matches m LEFT JOIN venues v ON v.venue_id = m.venue_id), inn AS (SELECT i.match_id, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 1 THEN i.batting_team_id END) bat1, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 1 THEN i.runs END) r1, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 2 THEN i.runs END) r2, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number = 2 THEN i.total_legal_balls END) b2, MAX(CASE WHEN i.innings_number > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) so FROM innings i GROUP BY i.match_id), dl AS (SELECT d.match_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.batter_runs = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) sixes, SUM(d.total_runs) runs FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY d.match_id) SELECT ms.*, CAST(strftime('%w', ms.dt) AS INTEGER) wd, inn.bat1, inn.r1, inn.r2, inn.b2, inn.so, COALESCE(dl.sixes, 0) sixes, COALESCE(dl.runs, 0) runs FROM ms JOIN inn ON inn.match_id = ms.match_id LEFT JOIN dl ON dl.match_id = ms.match_id ORDER BY ms.dt

cb-cmp.label: Chases won from a required rate of ten or more at halfway
cb-cmp.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
cb-cmp.filters: Second innings, required rate at the start of the eleventh over
cb-cmp.query: WITH h AS (SELECT d.innings_id, SUM(d.total_runs) runs10, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls10, MAX(CASE WHEN d.over_num >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) reached FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id WHERE i.innings_number = 2 GROUP BY d.innings_id), p AS (SELECT d.innings_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d.over_num < 10 THEN d.total_runs ELSE 0 END) r, SUM(CASE WHEN d.over_num < 10 AND (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) b FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id) SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, i.batting_team_id bt, m.winner_id w, (i1.runs + 1 - p.r) * 6.0 / (120 - p.b) rrr FROM innings i JOIN h ON h.innings_id = i.innings_id JOIN p ON p.innings_id = i.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id JOIN innings i1 ON i1.match_id = i.match_id AND i1.innings_number = 1 WHERE i.innings_number = 2 AND h.reached = 1 AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL
